# Unscii bitmap font

`unscii8.png` was copied unchanged from the official ngdevkit examples
repository. Unscii was created by Viznut and is public domain. It is used only
to build the Neo Geo fixed-layer font.

Source: <http://pelulamu.net/unscii/>
